    Lemma 8.11: opposite controls #

    lem:opposite-controls (local-ray-geometry.tex): generating rays f : b → c and g : c → a whose Homs are cyclic at c but not at their other endpoints. Here: the setting, the inclusions (eq:opposite-control-inclusions)

    (rad R_b) f ⊆ f q² R_c, A₀(c, b) f ⊆ (q²), and their duals for g,

    and the four-leaf star of Case 1, which gives the strong star vanishing (eq:strong-star-vanishing, local-ray-restrictions.tex): if fq, qg, q² ≠ 0 then fg = 0.
